title: esql.put_data_source
description:
Create or update an ES|QL data source.

Creates or replaces a named, type-specific data source configuration for ES|QL data federation.
Datasets reference data source configurations to access external data. Names must be lowercase
and follow index or alias naming rules.

master_timeout.description: Period to wait for a connection to the master node.

timeout.description: The time to wait for the request to be completed.

type.description:
The data source type. Currently, `s3` is supported.
The value must be lowercase and contain no whitespace.

description.description: A free-text description of the data source.

settings.description:
Type-specific connection and authentication settings.
For `s3`, connection settings include `region` and `endpoint`. Authentication settings
include `auth` and the credentials required by the selected authentication method.

name.description: The data source name to create or update.

error_trace.description:
When set to `true` Elasticsearch will include the full stack trace of errors
when they occur.

filter_path.description:
Comma-separated list of filters in dot notation which reduce the response
returned by Elasticsearch.

human.description:
When set to `true` will return statistics in a format suitable for humans.
For example `"exists_time": "1h"` for humans and
`"exists_time_in_millis": 3600000` for computers. When disabled the human
readable values will be omitted. This makes sense for responses being consumed
only by machines.

pretty.description:
If set to `true` the returned JSON will be "pretty-formatted". Only use
this option for debugging only.
